about: Restricted-grammar parse results. Expected values come from tomllib (the independent oracle); kitconfig's own parser must produce the same dict on every Python version.

cases.name: all section templates as shipped (every value UNSET)
cases.text:
# robinhood-skills:config  (every financial value ships UNSET; fill in only what you decided)
[policy]
read_scope = "ask"                  # ask | agentic_only | all
max_order_usd = "UNSET"
max_symbol_pct_household = "UNSET"
symbol_allowlist = []
symbol_denylist = []
earnings_blackout_days = "UNSET"
max_orders_per_day = "UNSET"
allow_options = "UNSET"
allow_crypto = "UNSET"
allowed_sessions = []
max_option_contracts = "UNSET"

[accounts]
retirement = []                 # last 4 of account_number, only if get_accounts does not identify retirement accounts

[tax]
min_loss_usd = "UNSET"          # show harvest candidates with unrealized loss >= this (UNSET = show all)
lookahead_days = "45"           # display window for long-term countdown (not a financial threshold)
related_tickers = []            # e.g. [["VOO","IVV"]]: groups YOU consider substantially identical
gtc_lookback_days = "90"        # data completeness for the buy sweep

[exits.equity]
stop_rule = "UNSET"        # "pct:8" (8% below current) | "atr:2.0:14" (2.0 x daily ATR(14) below current) | "ask"
target_rule = "UNSET"      # "pct:15" | "r:2" (2 x stop distance above current) | "none" | "ask"
time_in_force = "UNSET"    # "gfd" | "gtc"
backstop_alerts = "UNSET"  # "yes" | "no": offer a native price_below alert at the stop level
[exits.equity.symbols.NVDA]  # optional per-symbol overrides; prices as decimal strings
stop = "UNSET"
target = "UNSET"
[exits.crypto]
stop_rule = "UNSET"        # "pct:<n>" | "ask"
time_in_force = "UNSET"    # "gtc" (90 days) | "gfd" | "gfw" | "gfm"

[options.exits]
profit_target_pct = "UNSET"
stop_loss_pct = "UNSET"
time_stop_dte = "UNSET"
max_hold_days = "UNSET"
exit_price_rule = "UNSET"      # "bid" | "mid": how to price a closing limit when you ask for one
[options.monitor]
radar_days = "7"               # expiry radar window (not a financial threshold)

[options.criteria]
max_position_pct = "UNSET"
max_concurrent = "UNSET"             # counted with nonzero=true
max_cost_per_contract_usd = "UNSET"  # premium x 100
reserve_cash_usd = "UNSET"
price_min = "UNSET"
price_max = "UNSET"
min_avg_volume = "UNSET"
symbols_allowlist = []               # optional
symbols_blocklist = []               # optional
structure = "UNSET"                  # long_call | long_put | debit_call_spread | debit_put_spread
spread_width_min = "UNSET"           # spreads only; "OFF" for single-leg structures
spread_width_max = "UNSET"
dte_min = "UNSET"
dte_max = "UNSET"
delta_min = "UNSET"
delta_max = "UNSET"
max_spread_pct = "UNSET"
min_open_interest = "UNSET"
iv_rank_min = "UNSET"                # "OFF" to disable; if set, enforced via a verified scanner datapoint or the run stops
iv_rank_max = "UNSET"
earnings_policy = "UNSET"            # avoid | allow | require
earnings_buffer_days = "UNSET"
scan_sessions = "UNSET"              # "regular_hours_only" (the only supported value until non-regular windows are verified)
sort_by = "required_move_pct"        # disclosed sort; not a financial threshold
[options.entry]
entry_price_rule = "UNSET"           # ask_each_time | natural | mid
contracts_per_entry = "UNSET"        # positive integer (string)

[report]
window_days = "7"

cases.name: multi-line arrays, comments inside, trailing comma, nested pairs
cases.text:
[tax]
related_tickers = [
  ["VOO", "IVV", "SPLG"],   # S&P 500 funds I treat as identical
  ["QQQ", "QQQM"],
]
[policy]
symbol_denylist = [ "GME" , "AMC", ]
allowed_sessions = ["regular_hours"]
allow_options = true
allow_crypto = false

cases.name: string escapes, integers, booleans, header whitespace, implicit super-table
cases.text:
[ options . monitor ]
radar_days = 7
[options]
[report]
window_days = +7
note = "tab\there, quote \" and unicode \u00e9"
zero = 0
negative = -3
flag = true
